data.one_liner: Provide and retrieve values scoped to a BuildContext with automatic disposal.
data.what_it_does: Allows scoping, binding, and retrieving objects directly to a BuildContext without boilerplate. Values can be automatically initialized, lazily loaded, and disposed when the context is removed from the widget tree.
use_when: You want a hassle-free way to scope state or objects to a BuildContext
You need automatic cleanup and disposal of bound resources with the widget lifecycle
You prefer extension-based hooks or context-based object access instead of traditional InheritedWidgets
avoid_when: You need global application state independent of any BuildContext
You are using a state management pattern that strictly forbids context lookups
strengths: Automatic disposal of bound objects tied to the widget lifecycle
Minimal boilerplate compared to traditional InheritedWidget setup
Supports lazy initialization and pre-existing value binding
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to the widget tree via BuildContext
data.setup_notes: Wrap your app in a `ContextRef.root` widget and optionally wrap error handlers for better hot reload error messages.
